_comment: Fleet crew guardrails. Hooks fire identically in interactive and headless/CI mode. Each hook command resolves the MAIN checkout root via git's common dir, so hooks work from inside linked worktrees (.claude/worktrees/*).

hooks.command: r=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) && r=$(dirname "$r") || r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; f="$r/hooks/protect-paths.sh"; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "BLOCKED: path guard not found at $f. Failing closed; the edit was not allowed." >&2; exit 2; }; exec bash "$f"

r=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) && r=$(dirname "$r") || r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; f="$r/hooks/token-budget.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$f"

r=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) && r=$(dirname "$r") || r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; f="$r/hooks/session-ledger.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$f"
